objective: Identify optimal locations for a premium senior living and wellness retreat in India.
businessType: premium senior living and wellness retreat

layers.name: Tertiary hospital access
layers.whyItMatters: Proximity to healthcare is crucial for senior living facilities.

layers.name: Tranquility and green space
layers.whyItMatters: A tranquil environment enhances the wellness experience.
layers.proxyWarning: No direct tranquility data; using green space as a proxy.

layers.name: Connectivity to family
layers.whyItMatters: Easy access for visiting family is important for sustained occupancy.

layers.name: Existing retiree/wellness clusters
layers.whyItMatters: Proximity to similar facilities indicates a supportive ecosystem.

plan.methodology: Hierarchical: city screening for climate, healthcare, connectivity, then micro-market scoring for tranquility and access.

assumptions.assumption: Coimbatore, Pondicherry, and Dehradun are suitable cities.
assumptions.basis: Known retiree and wellness clusters with favorable climates.

misleadingVariables.risk: High density areas are less tranquil, which is negative for this business.

scenarios.name: Balanced
scenarios.description: Equal emphasis on tranquility, healthcare access, and connectivity.

scenarios.name: Tranquility-max
scenarios.description: Increased weight on tranquility and green space.

scenarios.name: Healthcare-max
scenarios.description: Increased weight on proximity to hospitals.

validation: Benchmark against successful retreats like Columbia Pacific Coimbatore.
modelFailureRisks: Healthcare access overstated without local validation.
